ram-boot.note: RAM boot through the green call key and USB loader.

local-console.note: Readable 240×320 terminal, physical keypad typing, modifiers, Help and diagnostic-console return.

lcd-backlight.note: System levels 0–10, initially 7; level 0 turns off the light, and brightness increases without visible flicker.

keypad-backlight.note: The keypad light turns on with physical key presses and goes out after inactivity.

usb-networking.note: USB-NCM with a local IPv4 DHCP connection to the PC.

ssh-access.note: Authenticated SSH over the local USB connection.

file-transfer.note: Upload and download to RAM; FAT32 and ext4 data-card reads and writes work.

cpu-clock-reporting.note: The CPU clock tool reports a lower-bound timing estimate.

manual-cpu-frequency-selection.note: Manual selection of 1 GHz and 768 MHz; 1 GHz is the default.

ap-dmaengine.note: The fixed ROTA peripheral request works; general memory-copy use is unqualified.

image-rotation-engine.note: RGB565 and NV16 90-degree rotation, including native 640×476 camera frames. Capture with one buffer can overlap rotation of a separately saved native frame; other formats, rotations and sustained concurrency are unqualified.

jpeg-engine.note: 320×240 NV16 encoding, full-size horizontal 4:2:2 decoding and 320×240→160×120 NV16 scaling. Other geometries and scaled decoding are unqualified.

native-image-output.note: RGB565 and NV16 image presentation on the 240×320 display.

image-rotation.note: CPU RGB565 rotation and hardware RGB565/NV16 90-degree rotation. Native capture with one buffer can stay active while hardware rotation processes a separately saved native frame.

jpeg-codec-and-scaling.note: Hardware 320×240 encode, horizontal 4:2:2 decode and 320×240→160×120 NV16 scaling. CPU JPEG also encodes native 640×476 frames; other scaling geometries are unqualified.

native-image-presentation.note: Native RGB565 and NV16 presentation; display appearance after sleep is unqualified.

removable-storage.note: FAT32 and ext4 data-card reads and writes in the RAM profile. Keep the card installed while powered; no hot-swap.

removable-system-root.note: Only the RAM root is supported on this target.

internal-phone-storage.note: Read-only physical NAND backup and fitted-data preparation. No mounting, writing or restoration.

headphone-audio.note: 24 and 48 kHz PCM with fitted EQ/ALC; four-contact headphones provide separate left/right speech and silence at volume 0. Jack insertion/removal is detected; other headset compatibility is unqualified.

speaker-audio.note: PCM speaker output with fitted EQ/ALC. Calibrated gain and speaker-only headphone mute are unqualified.

phone-microphone.note: Built-in mono 48 kHz capture and recognizable speech replay, including simultaneous 48 kHz playback; wired-headset capture is unqualified.

fm-radio.note: Recognizable station audio through wired headphones with fitted EQ/ALC; playback stops at the selected duration.

bluetooth.note: RAM pairing, bidirectional OPP, PAN data and Internet ping, and short SBC A2DP playback to a Linux PC. Physical Bluetooth peripherals and sustained operation are unqualified.

wi-fi.note: This target supplies its own external-radio implementation. RAM station and access-point modes work with WPA2-PSK/CCMP, DHCP and file transfer in both directions. Station DNS and HTTP Internet access work through a shared PC connection; sustained throughput is unqualified. Updating a running access point's beacon and per-station signal statistics are unsupported.

camera.note: Native GC032A 640×476 NV16, rotation 0°, unrotated pixels and capture after RTC wake. CPU JPEG and hardware rotation accept saved native frames. JPEG may process a separate compatible input during capture; one-buffer capture can overlap rotation of a separately saved native frame. Live pipelines, sustained concurrency and absolute color accuracy are unqualified.

charger-status.note: External-power detection and USB source classification work. Charging is unqualified.

battery-telemetry.note: Voltage, current and charge-counter interfaces are available. Battery measurements are unqualified; battery percentage is unavailable.

soc-temperature.note: SoC temperature readings respond; physical accuracy is unqualified.

real-time-clock.note: Clock readback and RTC-alarm wake in USB-powered RAM sessions.

vibration.note: Separate motor with binary FF_RUMBLE effects; short pulses and stopping are supported.

power-off.note: Battery-only power-off and powerbank output are unqualified.

suspend.note: USB-powered s2idle with RTC and red-call-key wake, readable display restoration, mounted ext4 storage and idle Bluetooth retaining its bond and post-wake transfer. Active-radio sleep is unqualified.

fplinux-armada.note: Application use on this phone is unqualified.

built-in-microphone.note: Built-in mono 48 kHz capture with simultaneous 48 kHz playback.

automatic-audio-routing.note: Output selection is explicit. Jack insertion/removal is detected; output switching remains manual.

bluetooth-pairing.note: Classic pairing in the RAM profile with a Linux PC.

bluetooth-file-transfer.note: Bidirectional OPP in the RAM profile; a transfer also works after RTC-woken idle Bluetooth sleep.

bluetooth-pan-internet.note: RAM PAN DHCP, bidirectional TCP transfer and external IPv4 ping work; DNS, HTTP and sustained operation over PAN are unqualified.

bluetooth-a2dp-linux-pc.note: Short 48 kHz stereo SBC playback to a Linux PC in the RAM profile; long playback, reconnect and suspend are unqualified.

bluetooth-a2dp-headsets.note: Physical Bluetooth headsets have not been tested.

bluetooth-keyboard.note: Physical Bluetooth keyboard input has not been tested.

bluetooth-mouse.note: Physical Bluetooth mouse input has not been tested.

microsd-hot-swap.stockNote: The normal stock procedure requires power-off and battery removal to reach the card.
microsd-hot-swap.note: Insert the card before boot and keep it installed throughout the powered session.

sim-hot-swap.stockNote: The normal stock procedure requires power-off and battery removal to reach the SIM slots.
sim-hot-swap.note: FPLinux has no supported cellular or SIM service path.

infrared-transmitter.note: FPLinux provides no infrared remote-control path.

gpu-rendering.note: No FPLinux GPU rendering path on this phone.
